svg.text: One Python process and one C++ helper process. Every module has a single responsibility.
position of C at time t
data — the scenario files and the content record;
logic — the kinematic model, and the codec inside the helper;
control — main.py, the rate loop, and the two input/output edges.
There is no user interface: the transmission log is the observation point.
the encoder is the same C++ codec the V2X ECU decodes with,
so the bench cannot re-implement it in Python without risking
divergence. The sources are copied byte-identically and the
output is verified against the reference messages.
